# mob_new v0.4.15 - Table of Contents

> Project generator for the Mob mobile framework

## Pages

- [mob_new](https://mob-new.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://mob-new.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [MobNew.LiveViewPatcher](https://mob-new.hexdocs.pm/MobNew.LiveViewPatcher.md): Pure helpers for applying the Mob LiveView bridge patches to a freshly
generated Phoenix project.
- [MobNew.NdkVersion](https://mob-new.hexdocs.pm/MobNew.NdkVersion.md): Mirror of `MobDev.NdkVersion`'s `@recommended` constant.
- [MobNew.ProjectGenerator](https://mob-new.hexdocs.pm/MobNew.ProjectGenerator.md): Generates a new Mob project from EEx templates in `priv/templates/mob.new/`.
- [MobNew.Templates.Lint](https://mob-new.hexdocs.pm/MobNew.Templates.Lint.md): Structural lints for generator-rendered native source files.
- [MobNew.VersionCheck](https://mob-new.hexdocs.pm/MobNew.VersionCheck.md): Best-effort "is a newer `mob.new` available?" check, in the spirit of
`phx.new`'s installer-version notice.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix mob.new](https://mob-new.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mob.New.md): Creates a new Mob project with Android and iOS boilerplate.
